text_block_list.text:
The GI race, the February Stakes, has 
finally arrived.

Haru Urara was thrilled to see so many 
people coming out to watch the race, 
bursting with excitement.

Any ordinary Umamusume would be nervous 
right before a major race, but the 
easygoing Haru Urara was acting just like 
her usual self.

She promised her Trainer that they would 
go see a "G-One" together after the race 
was over, and then headed out to the 
track.
